title: Repair Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission. 

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a leader in fleet management and a Lyft subsidiary, we're extending our expertise into autonomous vehicle (AV) infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep AV fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. Our Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion, and we're building the team to sustain and scale it.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Deployment, Flexdrive is seeking an exceptional Repair Operations Lead to help run the day-to-day service operations supporting our AV fleet. You'll work alongside a second Repair Operations Lead as a partnered pair, sharing coverage and accountability for the floor. This is a people-first leadership role. You will lead and mentor our repair coordinators, hold both the coordinator team and our on-site technicians (a 3rd party partner) accountable to quality and turnaround expectations, and keep the partnership running smoothly so the fleet stays available.

We're looking for a strong people leader rather than a deep technical expert. Service advisor or service drive experience is helpful because you'll be fluent in the workflow, but what matters most is your ability to develop a team, set clear expectations, and hold the line on them without losing the room. You should be comfortable managing an external partner relationship day to day, balancing a collaborative working rapport with firm accountability. You bring a teamwork mentality, genuinely care about employee relations and the culture you're building, and will lean into Lyft's values as one of the early leaders shaping how this site operates. If you're energized by growing people, building strong partner relationships, and bringing order to a fast-moving operation, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

  • Shift Pattern
    • This role supports 24/7 AV depot operations and requires availability to work day shifts, with hours scheduled between 5:00 PM - 1:30 AM, with alternating weekends with rotating weekdays off.
    • Specific shift times and schedules will be determined based on operational needs and business requirements.
    • Schedules will include weekends and holidays based on depot operational requirements.
  • Technical Team Management
    • Partnership Oversight & Accountability: Serve as the day-to-day point of accountability for our onsite repair partner, holding their technicians to agreed quality, turnaround, and certification standards across all shifts, and escalating gaps through the right channels before they affect fleet availability.
    • Workflow Distribution: Manage and optimize repair workflows across technician teams, balancing workload, prioritizing critical repairs, and ensuring SLA compliance for all maintenance activities.
    • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with the internal teams that own our third-party relationships and offsite collision repairs, acting as the site-level point of contact so vehicles route correctly, status stays visible, and repair timelines hold. You'll surface issues from the floor to those teams and carry their requirements back to the site so both sides stay aligned.
    • Performance Management: Conduct regular performance reviews, skills assessments, and development planning for technical staff, fostering a culture of safety, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Team Development & Coaching
    • Onboarding & Job Task Training: Get new repair coordinators up to speed on their core responsibilities — work order management, vehicle intake and staging, documentation, and the systems they'll live in day to day — so they're contributing confidently and correctly.
    • Depot Operations Fluency: Teach the team how the depot actually runs: how work flows from intake through repair and release, how their role connects to the technicians and the internal teams upstream and downstream, and what good looks like at each handoff.
    • Ongoing Coaching & Mentorship: Provide regular, direct feedback through side-by-sides, one-on-ones, and in-the-moment coaching. Identify where each coordinator wants to grow, build a path for them, and address performance gaps early and honestly.
  • Fleet Health & Maintenance Operations
    • Fleet Performance Optimization: Monitor and improve key metrics including Mean Time to Recovery, Vehicle Turnaround Time, and Diagnosis Escalation Rate.
    • Service Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain quality control processes ensuring all maintenance work meets partner specifications and safety standards.
    • Maintenance Planning: Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules, manage maintenance change requests, and ensure compliance with partner fleet management system requirements.
    • Technical Problem Resolution: Lead root cause analysis for technical issues working with our 3rd party partner, implementing corrective actions, and developing preventive measures to reduce repeat failures.
  • Parts & Materials Oversight
    • Service and Parts Coordinator Management: Directly supervise parts and service writing coordination, ensuring seamless integration between parts allocation, work order documentation, and inventory management while maintaining accuracy and compliance standards.
    • Supply Chain Coordination: Oversee Material Coordinator activities, ensuring optimal parts inventory levels, secure storage of proprietary components, and compliance with chain of custody standards.
    • Inventory Optimization: Analyze parts consumption patterns, forecast requirements, and coordinate with partner aftermarket teams to prevent stockouts while minimizing carrying costs.
    • Vendor Parts Management: Manage relationships with parts suppliers, negotiate service agreements, and ensure timely delivery of critical components.
    • Non-Conforming Parts Process: Oversee quarantine and disposition procedures for non-conforming parts, ensuring proper documentation and handling.
  • Compliance & Documentation
    • Training Compliance: Ensure all personnel maintain required qualifications through partner learning management systems, conducting monthly verification reviews per standards.
    • Safety Program Integration: Collaborate with the safety team to ensure all maintenance activities comply with EHS requirements, including battery safety, hazardous materials handling, and hot work procedures.
    • Documentation Management: Maintain comprehensive documentation hierarchy including job descriptions, safety protocols, training records, and maintenance logs per partner requirements.
    • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all technical operations meet federal, state, and local regulations including EPA, OSHA, and AV-specific requirements.
  • Strategic Planning & Continuous Improvement
    • Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, analyzing performance data to identify optimization opportunities and implement best practices across technical operations.
    • Capacity Planning: Forecast staffing needs, training requirements, and infrastructure upgrades to support fleet growth and operational scaling.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations Manager, Depot Operations Leads, and partner technical teams to ensure seamless integration of maintenance and depot operations.
    • Knowledge Management: Establish and maintain technical knowledge base, documenting lessons learned, best practices, and troubleshooting guides for common issues.
    • Culture of Safety:  Champion a comprehensive culture of safety through proactive engagement.  Leading by example in following all safety requirements; educating the team on safety protocols; proactively identifying risks; managing incidents, including reporting and investigation.
  • Technical Competencies
    • Advanced diagnostic skills for electric and autonomous vehicle systems
    • Proficiency with fleet management systems (Carman experience preferred)
    • SAP or similar ERP system expertise for parts and maintenance tracking
    • Data analysis and reporting capabilities for performance metrics
    • Understanding of ISO quality standards and automotive compliance requirements

Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Automotive Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
  • 4+ years of progressive experience in fleet maintenance management, automotive service operations, or technical training leadership.
  • 3+ years of experience managing technical teams including hiring, training, performance management, and development of skilled technicians.
  • 2+ years of experience developing and delivering technical training programs, preferably in automotive or fleet maintenance environments.
  • Proven expertise in electric vehicle systems, diagnostic procedures, and advanced automotive technologies (AV experience highly preferred).
  • Strong understanding of maintenance management systems, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision making for fleet operations.
  • Experience with vendor management, contract negotiation, and third-party service provider oversight.
  • Demonstrated success implementing quality management systems, safety management systems  and continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean preferred).
  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to interface effectively with technical teams, executive leadership, and external partners.
  • Current ASE certifications preferred; ability to obtain required partner certifications within 90 days.
  • Valid driver's license with clean driving record.

Benefits:

  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
  • 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
  • Subsidized commuter benefits
  • Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Note: For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.

This role is on-site at a Lyft Flexdrive hub or office location full time. #Onsite

title: Applied Scientist Intern, PhD (Summer 2027)
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Lyft Rider Science team is seeking an Applied Scientist intern to develop next-generation user simulation methods using state of the art AI methods. The goal of this project is to develop and validate LLM-based Rider Agents that can serve as behavioral proxies for real riders, and study when agent simulations can provide reliable signal about rider responses to product interventions before online experimentation.

You will build agent-based simulation systems grounded in real rider context and behavioral data, evaluate their fidelity against observed rider behavior and historical experiments, and study where these simulations can accelerate product iteration and experimentation.

This role combines LLM engineering, agent-based modeling, machine learning, and causal inference with direct applications to real-world rider products. The expected outcome is to build a working Rider Agent simulation prototype, establish an evaluation framework for measuring simulation fidelity and validate the framework using historical rider experiments.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop LLM-based Rider Agents that represent heterogeneous rider contexts, preferences, histories, and behaviors
  • Build agent-based simulation environments for evaluating rider interactions with different product experiences and interventions
  • Build evaluation pipelines to assess realism, robustness, and mechanism plausibility of simulated behavior against human data or established theory
  • Analyze emergent behaviors and interaction dynamics in simulated populations under different user segment and marketplace conditions
  • Conduct experiments and ablation studies on agent behavior, interaction dynamics, and simulation validity
  • Apply the simulation framework to real Rider product problems and assess its usefulness for hypothesis generation, product iteration, and pre-experiment evaluation
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations to science, engineering, and product partners

Experience:

  • Currently pursuing a PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field, with a graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required)
  • Proficiency with Python and working in a production coding environment
  • Hands-on experience with large language models or agent-based systems
  • Strong foundation in machine learning and empirical model evaluation
  • Ability to independently develop prototypes and work through open-ended technical problems
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, or experimental design
  • Bonus Points:
    • Experience building production level ML inference, simulation, or evaluation pipelines
    • Prior research experience with LLM agents, generative user simulation, or agent-based modeling
    • Background in computational social science or behavioral modeling
    • Experience evaluating AI systems against human behavioral data, qualitative studies, or controlled experiments
    • Familiarity with prompting, tool use, memory, planning, or coordination in LLM-based agents
    • Publication record in relevant venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, AAAI, ICML or ACL/EMNLP
    • Interest in building simulation platforms that support hypothesis generation, intervention testing, or human-AI system design

title: Salesforce Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We're looking for a Salesforce Architect to own the architecture of Lyft's commercial platform as it grows through acquisition. Reporting to the Manager, Sales Technology, you will define the target-state architecture across our Salesforce orgs, lead the consolidation of acquired-company CRM environments into Lyft's platform, and decide where data is unified versus federated. You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Finance, Data, Privacy, and Legal partners to turn a reactive delivery function into a business enabler.

If you are a candidate who has the vision of what could be, who has the ability to cultivate relationships, and a belief in developing the skills and talents of others, then you may be the ideal person for this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive enterprise wide programs articulating program/project strategies on enabling technologies leveraging the Salesforce Platform.
  • Identify and drive the Lyft’s organizational needs for Salesforce foundations, define the business or technology architecture, plan how large projects will be delivered, oversee the solution design and implementation.
  • Effectively drive user experience and design strategies across Enterprise for platform adoption.
  • Advise and mentor diverse teams and product groups on resources in technical and functional delivery aspects at a program level, using influence and adaptive communication strategies.
  • Lead large cross-team system design discussions, offering alternate choices, trade-offs, and impact analysis with a focus on long-term solutions.
  • Provide guidance on application and integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and functional/technical solution architecture, including environment management, testing of the Salesforce Platform.
  • Provide evidence-based design patterns for development of solutions on the Salesforce platform such as managed vs unmanaged packages, config vs low-code vs code, custom build vs native/appExchange offerrings.
  • Drive the adoption of best engineering development practices across multiple Salesforce Orgs and promote the creation of application and technical design documents that align with Salesforce best practices and seamless integration into Lyft's infrastructure.
  • Possess deep understanding of native Salesforce features and functionality, as well as the ability to model a role hierarchy, data model, and appropriate sharing mechanisms.
  • Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the salesforce adoption and return on investment and serve as an active contributor to engineering.
  • Identification and proactive management of risk areas across enterprise and commitment to seeing an issue through to complete resolution.
  • Lead assessment of architecture environment and requirements and design sound, scalable, and high-performing solutions on the Salesforce Platform that meet the Single Sign-on (SSO) requirements.
  • Lead the technical integration of acquired companies' CRM and GTM systems, including org strategy (consolidate vs. federate), data migration, deduplication and identity resolution, object and picklist harmonization, and decommissioning of legacy orgs.
  • Define and maintain the multi-org architecture and data model, including cross-org reporting, shared reference data, and territory/hierarchy design that survives each acquisition.
  • Own the integration architecture connecting Salesforce to middleware (Boomi, Workato) and the wider GTM stack, and re-platform acquired companies' equivalents onto Lyft standards.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Security on data residency, retention, and subject-rights requirements as newly acquired entities bring additional countries into scope.

Experience:

  • 8+ years building enterprise solutions on Salesforce, including hands-on work with the SOAP/REST, Bulk, Pub/Sub, Tooling, and Metadata APIs
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect and System Architect
  • Experience owning architecture across multiple Salesforce orgs, including at least one org consolidation, migration, or merge
  • Strong integration experience with Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or comparable middleware
  • Data management depth: SQL/RDBMS, structured and unstructured stores, large-scale data migration and matching/dedupe
  • CI/CD on the Salesforce platform (Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, or similar)
  • Experience transitioning Salesforce processes into agentic AI solutions
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) for unifying or federating customer data across multiple orgs or acquired entities — zero-copy federation, harmonization to a canonical model, and identity resolution
    • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect
    • M&A carve-out or post-merger integration experience in a GTM/commercial systems context
    • Experience leading implementations across multiple countries with differing data-protection requirements

title: Counsel, Patents & IP
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

This position will manage Lyft's patent function — driving the strategy and day-to-day management of our patent portfolio — while also advising on the company's approach to open source, reviewing technical publications before they go external, and serving as a trusted advisor on IP questions across the business. This position will report to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, IP. Beyond the legal chops, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships — you'll spend as much time with engineers and researchers as you will with lawyers, so a warm, curious, low-ego style goes a long way here. We value people who can make patent law feel approachable rather than intimidating, who bring a sense of humor to a fast-moving environment, and who are as excited about celebrating an inventor's first disclosure as they are about closing out a tricky filing decision. This is a great opportunity for someone to come in and manage the patent function at Lyft, working on cutting-edge issues spanning Lyft's global expansion, Lyft Urban Solutions' mobility hardware and software business, and supporting the deployment and expansion of autonomous vehicles on Lyft's network.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the patent portfolio end to end for the company — invention harvesting, invention disclosure meetings, portfolio mining, and directing patent application preparation and prosecution by outside patent counsel.
  • Drive patent strategy and drive filing, continuation, and abandonment decisions based on technical merit, competitive landscape, and cost, and own portfolio health and reporting against product roadmaps.
  • Counsel and collaborate with engineering on open source license review and approval for inbound and outbound open source, including license compatibility and compliance risk.
  • Review papers, blog posts, conference talks, and other public technical disclosures for IP and confidentiality risk and relevant counseling.
  • Provide broad-based strategic and portfolio advice as well as counseling key stakeholders in protecting and defending IP rights worldwide.
  • Support IP diligence for partnerships, M&A, and vendor relationships.
  • Train and educate product and engineering teams in intellectual property matters, and build tools, policies, and processes that scale with the business.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of patent prosecution experience in a relevant area; in-house patent portfolio building/management experience a plus.
  • Experience advising on open source license compliance.
  • Must be a member of the Patent Bar and have substantial understanding of patent law outside of litigation.
  • Must be proactive, self-directed, detail oriented, organized, and have exceptional communication skills.
  • Adaptable and positive under shifting priorities, with the flexibility to move between deep legal work and lighter-touch, high-volume counseling on any given day.
  • Demonstrate AI fluency and comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work.
  • JD required.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical field.
  • State bar membership.

  • Sense of humor and comfort with shifting priorities.

title: Data Scientist, Decisions - Mapping
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

As a Data Scientist on the Mapping team, you will collaborate with our world class team of engineers, product managers, and designers to grow and improve the quality of recommended routes and accuracy of our travel time estimations. We're looking for a passionate, driven Data Scientist who is excited to dive into our spatial data and build a best-in-class mapping product that provides safe, efficient, and seamless navigation for our rideshare drivers.

Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our mapping products and make business decisions that put our customers first. This will involve identifying and scoping opportunities, shaping priorities, recommending technical solutions, designing experiments, and measuring the impact of new features. You will help us solve some of the most impactful problems in mapping, including:

  • How do we improve the quality of our map data in order to improve our recommendations?
  • How do we benchmark and measure the success of our services?
  • How do we validate features of the real world that affect our routing algorithms?
  • Are we meeting our travel estimation promises to our customers?

  • Design and analyze online experiments; communicate results and act on launch decisions

title: Data Scientist, Algorithms - Dynamic Pricing
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Marketplace team at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while simultaneously delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection is an integral part of that. Our team is the dynamic pricing team responsible for leveraging both real-time and historical data to set prices for every single ride at Lyft while balancing prices and ETAs to better serve our riders’ needs.

We are looking for fast learning, data-driven individuals who are passionate about tackling these open-ended problems in pricing theory and making a large, positive impact in the business. title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundational Infrastructure & Networking
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft’s Infrastructure organization builds the high-scale foundation that every engineer at Lyft relies on to ship safe, performant, and reliable services.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Foundational Infrastructure & Networking team, you will own the core routing, service mesh, and control planes that power hundreds of microservices processing millions of rides daily. This is an IC role with massive engineering leverage: your technical architecture, systems design, and performance optimizations will directly amplify the velocity of every software engineer across Lyft while ensuring platform resiliency at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Architect & Scale Core Networking: Design, build, and optimize our service mesh, ingress/egress infrastructure, and edge routing capabilities using Envoy Proxy and custom control planes on AWS.
  • Optimize High-Throughput Control Planes: Enhance load-balancing algorithms, service discovery, and dynamic scaling mechanisms across high-concurrency data and control planes running on Kubernetes.
  • Drive Systems Reliability & Observability: Operationalize deep telemetry, metrics, and distributed tracing across our networking stack to drastically reduce mean-time-to-detect (MTTD) and resolution (MTTR).
  • Hands-on Production Debugging: Lead complex technical investigations into cross-stack incidents spanning kernel parameters, cloud VPC network layers, DNS, and distributed microservice protocols.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Elevate engineering rigor through RFC reviews, technical vision, incident response post-mortems, and mentoring engineers across the broader Infrastructure org.

Experience

  • 6+ Years of Production Systems Experience: Proven track record building and operating massive-scale cloud infrastructure and networking platforms.
  • Expertise in Cloud Networking & Protocols: Deep understanding of Linux networking, TCP/IP, DNS, gRPC, HTTP/2, load balancing, and AWS networking architecture (VPCs, NLBs, subnets, transit gateways).
  • Service Mesh & Proxy Expertise: Hands-on experience building or operating large-scale proxy and mesh technologies (e.g., Envoy, Istio, Cilium, Nginx).
  • Cloud & Container Infrastructure: Strong experience managing production Kubernetes clusters running on public cloud providers (AWS/GCP) using Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform).
  • Distributed Systems Troubleshooting: Demonstrated skill in isolating and debugging complex, multi-layered system failures under high throughput conditions.

title: Analyste en Planification des Actifs
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes.

Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle.

L'équipe de Lyft Urban Solutions à Montréal est en pleine croissance, et nous recherchons un(e) Analyste en planification des actifs. Ce rôle soutiendra la planification et l'allocation des pièces de rechange dans tous les marchés de micromobilité où Lyft est présente. Vous veillerez à ce que les bonnes pièces de réparation arrivent dans les bons marchés au bon moment, afin que les vélos et les trottinettes restent en circulation et que la clientèle puisse compter sur eux.

Nous cherchons une personne ayant un esprit analytique et motivée par la mise en place de processus évolutifs. Dans ce rôle, la personne devra élaborer des prévisions rigoureuses, puis les transformer en solutions à long terme qui fonctionnent concrètement sur le terrain. Ce poste évolue dans un environnement au rythme rapide, aux côtés des équipes d'opérations locales, des équipes de planification de l'approvisionnement et d'autres parties prenantes interfonctionnelles. L'Analyste doit être aussi à l'aise pour bâtir un modèle que pour obtenir l'adhésion des chefs de file du marché.

Responsabilités:

  • Assurer la prévision de la demande, la gestion des stocks, l'optimisation et l'allocation des pièces actuelles et futures de Lyft. 
  • Créer des modèles auditables : hypothèses, entrées et sorties clairement définies, et suivi des modifications entre les versions.
  • Mettre en œuvre des processus et des cadres de référence transparents pour garantir l'alignement des équipes de direction et des équipes commerciales sur les besoins en pièces.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales locales, les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes pour améliorer en continu les processus et les tableaux de bord de planification de la demande de pièces.
  • Utiliser les données pour recommander des initiatives matérielles et opérationnelles, telles que la mise à niveau des composantes, l'amélioration des outils, les programmes d'incitation ou les cadres de gestion de la performance.
  • Piloter des projets spéciaux selon les besoins.
  • Déplacements occasionnels sur les marchés, dans les entrepôts et chez les fournisseurs.

Expérience:

  • 3+ années d'expérience en conseil, stratégie et opérations, chaîne d'approvisionnement, transport, planification, analyse ou domaine connexe.
  • Excellentes compétences quantitatives et financières.
  • Maîtrise avancée d'Excel ou en création de modèles de feuilles de calcul sur Google Sheets indispensable. La connaissance de SQL est un atout.
  • Une expérience en gestion de fournisseurs est un plus.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale, avec une capacité à adapter le message et le support selon l'auditoire, ainsi que la facilité à collaborer efficacement à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.
  • Fort sens des responsabilités. Vous êtes passionné(e) par l'optimisation des processus et l'amélioration continue.
  • Capacité à simplifier la complexité en alliant vision et précision.
  • Proactivité et implication face à l'incertitude.
  • Curiosité et capacité d'apprentissage rapide de nouveaux concepts couvrant les opérations, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les produits, l'ingénierie, la conception, les partenariats urbains et plus encore.

Avantages:

  • Excellente couverture d’assurance santé, dentaire, vision, ainsi que l’assurance vie et prestation d’invalidité
  • Programme de soutien en santé mentale
  • Soutien à la fertilité et à la planification familiale

La politique permet aux membres de l’équipe de prendre autant de temps qu’ils en ont besoin (avec l’approbation du gestionnaire). Les membres de l’équipe payés à l’heure bénéficient de 15 jours de congés payés, avec un jour supplémentaire pour chaque année de service
  • Lyft est fier de soutenir les nouveaux parents avec 18 semaines de congés payés, conçu comme une complémentarité aux programmes gouvernementaux. Les parents biologiques, adoptifs et adoptifs sont tous élus.

title: Senior Product Manager, Verticals
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco headquarters.

Lyft's Verticals team owns three of the most strategically important and operationally complex marketplaces in our business: airports, scheduled rides, and events. These are the moments that matter most. Airports are a defining touchpoint in the Lyft experience: high-stakes, high-complexity, and critical to both rider trust and driver earnings. Scheduled rides give riders confidence and control while giving drivers greater predictability. Events, from packed stadium concerts to sold-out games, require precision logistics and seamless coordination at scale. Together, these verticals represent some of the highest-intent, highest-value use cases on the Lyft platform.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Verticals team, you'll lead a cross-functional team to shape how millions of people plan, book, and experience their journeys across these critical moments. You'll build seamless booking flows, deeply personalized experiences, and robust integrations with travel and event partners. You'll also take on some of the most complex challenges in rideshare: optimizing rider-driver matching in dynamic, high-variability environments, advancing demand forecasting, improving real-time driver guidance, and designing targeted incentives that drive growth. The solutions you build need to work everywhere, from a quiet regional airport to JFK, and from a Tuesday morning scheduled ride to 60,000 fans leaving a stadium at once.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand Lyft's strategic and competitive position. Set goals and success metrics that align with Lyft's mission and drive maximum impact based on data analysis, market research, and usability studies
  • Set an incredibly ambitious vision that motivates and inspires your team, peers, and leadership, and that accounts for the distinct dynamics of airports, scheduled rides, and events
  • Completely own your team's products, existing or new, from ideation through development, experimentation, launch, growth, and maintenance, caring deeply about both rider and driver experiences
  • Lead and align cross-functional partners, including engineers, designers, data scientists, analysts, marketers, business partners, and operations, to drive a shared vision
  • Communicate clear roadmaps, priorities, experiments, and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executive leadership

Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, product design, or equivalent consulting experience with significant time spent leading consumer mobile apps or marketplace products
  • Experience working with or alongside data science and operations teams on complex products; familiarity with experimentation, marketplace dynamics, or logistics is a plus
  • Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation
  • Natural ability to make things happen around you. You manage project ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way
  • Strong ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products and the health of the business
  • Excellent judgment and thoughtfulness about the dynamics of a product ecosystem, including balancing the needs of riders and drivers
  • Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level: within teams, with partner teams, and to executive leadership
  • Experience leading post-launch optimizations, including developing testing strategies
  • Ability to conceptualize, manage, and prioritize multiple projects for stakeholders
  • Detail oriented with superior organizational skills. Balancing multiple projects, deadlines, and requests should be second nature to you

title: Stagiaire en ingénierie de la qualité terrain, matériel (été 2027)
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lyft, notre raison d'être est de servir et de connecter. Lyft Urban Solutions conçoit, fabrique et exploite des systèmes de vélopartage dans plus de 50 villes à travers le monde, dont New York, Chicago, Londres, Barcelone, Mexico, Rio de Janeiro et Montréal. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde.

Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en ingénierie de la qualité terrain, matériel pour se joindre à notre équipe Qualité terrain (Field Quality) à notre établissement de Longueuil. Une fois que nos vélos, vélos électriques, batteries et stations quittent l'usine, l'équipe Qualité terrain est responsable de leur comportement en conditions réelles : des millions de trajets, en toutes saisons, dans des villes partout dans le monde. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs en qualité terrain pour aider à détecter les problèmes matériels émergents, à en investiguer la cause profonde et à soutenir la mise en place de correctifs avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et des opérations dans les marchés. Vous passerez du temps en laboratoire à manipuler des pièces défaillantes, et tout autant dans les données à évaluer l'ampleur réelle d'un problème.

Responsabilités :

  • Soutenir les analyses de défaillance sur des pièces retournées du terrain, y compris les demandes des clients entreprises, en participant au démontage, à l'inspection et aux essais électriques et en documentant les constats avec photos.
  • Aider à surveiller les données terrain, comme les alertes des véhicules et des stations et les historiques de réparation, et signaler les problèmes émergents à l'équipe.
  • Concevoir et mettre à jour des tableaux de bord et des requêtes pour suivre les indicateurs de fiabilité et l'avancement des mises à niveau.
  • Participer aux campagnes de mise à niveau sur le terrain en aidant à repérer les unités touchées et en suivant l'avancement.
  • Aider à réviser les PON de réparation et les guides de diagnostic utilisés par les mécaniciens des marchés, et proposer des améliorations.
  • Contribuer aux enquêtes sur les défaillances terrain dans Jira, en collaboration avec les ingénieurs, pour l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives.

Expérience :

  • Être inscrit ou inscrite à un programme de baccalauréat ou de maîtrise en génie mécanique, électrique, mécatronique ou industriel, ou dans un domaine connexe, dans une université canadienne, avec une fin d'études prévue entre décembre 2027 et l'été 2028 (obligatoire). title: Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft Urban Solutions designs, builds, and operates bikeshare systems in more than 50 cities worldwide, including New York, Chicago, London, Barcelona, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, and Montréal. Our Longueuil facility is the birthplace of BIXI, North America's first automated bikeshare system, and today builds the bikes and stations behind some of the world's largest bikeshare networks.

We are looking for a Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern to join our Field Quality team at our Longueuil facility. Once our bikes, e-bikes, batteries, and stations leave the factory, Field Quality owns how they hold up in the real world: millions of rides, all four seasons, in cities across the globe. You will work alongside field quality engineers to help spot emerging hardware issues, investigate their root cause, and support fixes with engineering, manufacturing, and market operations teams. You will spend time hands-on with failed parts in the lab, and just as much time in the data working out how big a problem really is.

Responsibilities:

  • Support failure analysis on parts returned from the field, including requests from enterprise customers, by helping with teardown, inspection, and electrical testing and documenting findings with photos.
  • Help monitor field data, such as vehicle and station alerts and repair records, and flag emerging issues to the team.
  • Build and update dashboards and queries that track reliability metrics and retrofit progress.
  • Assist with field retrofit campaigns by helping identify affected units and tracking progress.
  • Help review repair SOPs and troubleshooting guides used by market mechanics, and suggest improvements.
  • Contribute to field failure investigations in Jira, working with engineers on root cause and corrective actions.

Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, at a Canadian university, graduating between December 2027 and summer 2028 (required). Master's students who worked between degrees should have less than 2 years of full-time experience.
  • Professional proficiency in French and English, written and spoken (required)
  • Hands-on comfort with electromechanical hardware, including disassembly, inspection, and basic electrical troubleshooting with tools like a multimeter
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets to reach clear conclusions
  • Familiarity with structured problem-solving methods (5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, 8D, FMEA)
  • Curious and detail-oriented, with clear written communication
  • Previous internship or co-op in quality, reliability, test, or failure analysis is a plus
  • SQL or Python, and experience with Mode, Hex, Tableau, or Power BI, is a plus
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing tools is a plus
  • Exposure to e-bikes, batteries, automotive, or other electromechanical products, or to reading wiring diagrams, is a plus

Benefits:

  • Mental health benefits
  • In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off
  • Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

title: Associate Counsel, Employment
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a bright, pragmatic, and self-motivated employment attorney with 4+ years of employment counseling and litigation experience to join our growing global Legal team. The ideal candidate will leverage their prior law firm and/or in-house experience to provide thoughtful, timely, practical and business-minded legal advice primarily to the professionals on Lyft’s Employee Relations and People teams across the globe. You must have experience litigating and/or counseling on compliance with federal and state anti-discrimination/harassment/retaliation laws, preferably including analysis of issues under California law. Prior in-house or seconded technology company experience is preferred but not required. The successful candidate will be an entrepreneurial and resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, excellent at building strong relationships and interested in learning more about supporting a global workforce.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide pragmatic day-to-day employment advice and counseling on a broad range of employment issues in order to balance business impact and legal risk including HR practices, performance management, terminations, leaves of absence, investigations, and employee accommodations.
  • Investigate pre-litigation and litigation matters. Develop and implement strategies for early resolution (as appropriate) and work with outside counsel as appropriate.
  • Provide guidance and Interpret policies and procedures, incorporating knowledge of state and federal employment laws (e.g., FMLA, ADA, FLSA, NLRA, and Title VII and equivalent state and international laws).
  • Provide legal counsel and support to a global workforce.
  • Partner closely with Lyft’s Employee Relations and People team professionals on employee complaints and investigations, performance management, and accommodations.
  • Collaborate with other members of the Employment Legal Team and People Team to develop strong processes to ensure compliance with applicable state, federal and local laws.
  • Develop and deliver training to managers and employees -- candidates must be comfortable with public speaking.
  • Monitor important developments in employment law in jurisdictions across the country and internationally, striving to spot trends in their infancy.
  • Work and build trust with cross-functional partners from teams across the Legal Department and the Company.
  • Travel from time-to-time as necessary to service internal clients; develop cross-office relationships; and attend legal proceedings/negotiations.\

Experience:

  • 4+ years practicing employment law at a leading law firm and/or in-house, with experience and/or interest in advice and counseling
  • Prior in-house experience and expertise supporting a global workforce is a plus but not required.
  • Active and in good standing with a State Bar and eligible to practice in the relevant jurisdiction where you are located. 
  • J.D. from a top-tier law school
  • Excellent problem-solving capabilities, judgment, communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills
  • Adept at thinking creatively (and strategically!) on your feet, conveying grace under pressure, and simultaneously managing complex workloads, multiple client demands, and shifting priorities all while instilling confidence
  • Resourceful self-starter and have a passion for results. Embody Lyft’s culture, and operate with high standards and ethics

title: People Business Partner, Lyft Urban Solutions
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.

As the People Business Partner for LUS, you'll be the go-to people partner, and will also serve as the primary People lead for the Montreal site. You'll translate business priorities into practical people plans, help managers lead through complex people issues, and make sure our programs land properly in a Quebec context. You'll report into the Senior People Business Partner for our Global Growth team, and work closely with Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Operations and Legal.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being close to the business. Success looks like a deep understanding of the team’s objectives, metrics, performance, and opportunities in order to craft People strategies that enable those objectives. You are equally comfortable coaching a new manager through a difficult conversation and helping a director think through how their team should be structured next year.

 Responsibilities:

  • Partnering with managers and leaders across LUS on team health, performance, development and retention, providing thought partnership that's direct, practical and grounded in the business.
  • Leading the People responsibilities for the Montreal site, including liaising with CNESST, the OQLF, and running the 1% Training Law program.
  • Manage people rhythms autonomously and with excellence: bringing performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, workforce planning, organizational health reporting and engagement surveys to life for your client groups, and making sure managers are ready for each.
  • Supporting employee relations matters with care and sound judgement, from first conversation through to resolution, partnering with Employee Relations and Legal where cases are complex.
  • Supporting organizational changes, from small team restructures to larger shifts in how LUS is organized, including planning, manager preparation, project management and team member communication.
  • Applying Quebec employment law and practice to Lyft's global programs, and flagging early where something needs to be adapted locally.
  • Using data to spot patterns, such as attrition, engagement and hiring trends, and bringing them to leaders with a clear view on what to do next.
  • Partnering with Finance to track headcount cost, holding leaders accountable and advising on headcount shifts to remain neutral to budget while optimizing for business outcomes.
  • Being a visible, trusted presence on site, particularly for teams who don't sit at a desk all day.

title: Partenaire d’affaires RH, Lyft Solutions Urbaines
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Lyft Solutions Urbaines (souvent appelé LUS) crée des programmes de vélopartage que les usagers adorent, dont les villes ont besoin et que les exploitants apprécient. Nous concevons, fabriquons et soutenons les vélos et la technologie des stations qui font fonctionner des programmes de vélopartage dans des villes du monde entier, dont BIXI. Notre équipe de Montréal est au cœur de ce travail : elle réunit sous un même toit les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'opérations, de marketing et commerciales.

À titre de partenaire d'affaires RH pour LUS, vous serez la personne-ressource de référence en matière de gestion des personnes et agirez également comme principal responsable RH du site de Montréal. Vous traduirez les priorités d'affaires en plans RH concrets, aiderez les gestionnaires à composer avec des enjeux humains complexes et veillerez à ce que nos programmes soient bien adaptés au contexte québécois. Vous relèverez du partenaire d'affaires RH principal de notre équipe Global Growth et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Relations avec les employés, Rémunération globale, Acquisition de talents, Opérations RH et Affaires juridiques.

Il s'agit d'un rôle très opérationnel pour une personne qui aime être proche des activités. Pour réussir, vous devrez bien comprendre les objectifs, les indicateurs, la performance et les opportunités de l'équipe afin d'élaborer des stratégies RH qui les soutiennent. Vous êtes tout aussi à l'aise d'accompagner un nouveau gestionnaire dans une conversation difficile que d'aider un directeur à réfléchir à la structure de son équipe pour l'année à venir.

Responsabilités:

  • Agir comme partenaire auprès des gestionnaires et des leaders de LUS sur la santé des équipes, la performance, le développement et la rétention, en offrant un accompagnement stratégique direct, pragmatique et ancré dans la réalité des affaires.
  • Assumer les responsabilités RH du site de Montréal, notamment les liens avec la CNESST et l'OQLF, ainsi que la gestion du programme lié à la Loi favorisant le développement et la reconnaissance des compétences de la main-d'œuvre (loi du 1 %).
  • Gérer de façon autonome et avec rigueur les cycles RH : mettre en œuvre les évaluations de rendement, les cycles de rémunération, les revues de talents, la planification de la main-d'œuvre, les rapports sur la santé organisationnelle et les sondages d'engagement pour vos groupes clients, en vous assurant que les gestionnaires sont prêts pour chacun d'eux.
  • Soutenir les dossiers de relations de travail avec bienveillance et discernement, de la première conversation jusqu'à la résolution, en collaboration avec les équipes Relations avec les employés et Affaires juridiques pour les dossiers complexes.
  • Soutenir les changements organisationnels, qu'il s'agisse de petites restructurations d'équipe ou de transformations plus importantes de l'organisation de LUS, y compris la planification, la préparation des gestionnaires, la gestion de projet et la communication auprès des membres de l'équipe.
  • Appliquer le droit et les pratiques du travail du Québec aux programmes mondiaux de Lyft, et signaler rapidement tout élément nécessitant une adaptation locale.
  • Utiliser les données pour dégager des tendances (roulement, engagement, embauche, etc.) et les présenter aux leaders avec une recommandation claire sur les prochaines étapes.
  • Collaborer avec l'équipe Finances pour suivre les coûts liés aux effectifs, responsabiliser les leaders et les conseiller sur les ajustements d'effectifs afin de respecter le budget tout en optimisant les résultats d'affaires.
  • Assurer une présence visible et de confiance sur le site, particulièrement auprès des équipes qui ne travaillent pas derrière un bureau.

Expérience:

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en RH, dont au moins 2 à 3 ans dans un rôle de partenaire d'affaires RH ou de conseiller RH généraliste soutenant directement des gestionnaires.
  • Connaissance pratique du droit du travail québécois et expérience de son application.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
  • Solide expérience en gestion des relations de travail, notamment les enquêtes, la gestion du rendement et les fins d'emploi.
  • Expérience auprès d'employés salariés de bureau et de personnel payé à l'heure, de première ligne ou travaillant sur site.
  • Expérience dans une entreprise en période d'intégration, de restructuration ou de forte croissance, un atout.
  • Aisance avec les systèmes RH (Workday ou équivalent) et avec l'utilisation des données pour appuyer des recommandations.

Avantages:

  • Programme de soutien en santé mentale

title: Senior PBP, Finance
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

As Senior People Business Partner for Finance, you'll be the strategic people partner to Finance leadership. Lyft's Finance organization spans FP&A, accounting, tax, treasury, investor relations, procurement, and increasingly operates across multiple countries and legal entities as Lyft grows internationally. You'll help shape how the organization is structured, how it plans its workforce, how it builds and keeps its talent, and how it adapts as the business changes. You'll be a trusted, candid advisor to our CFO and Finance leadership team, someone who understands the numbers as well as the people, and who is confident enough to push back when the plan doesn't add up.

You'll report into People Business Partner leadership and work closely with Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Team Member Experience and Legal. This role carries significant scope and autonomy, and suits someone who can operate at executive level while still getting into the details when it matters.

Responsibilities:

  • Advising Finance leadership, up to the executive level, on the people implications of business decisions, bringing a clear point of view rather than a list of options.
  • Leading organizational design across Finance: spans and layers, team structures, role clarity and the reorganizations that come with growth, integration and change.
  • Owning workforce planning and talent strategy for the Finance organisation: headcount, skills, location strategy and the trade-offs between them; talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and retention of critical people, including across newly integrated international teams.
  • Guiding leaders through complex change, including restructures and M&A integration, with a clear plan, well-prepared managers and honest communication.
  • Shaping compensation and performance decisions through the annual cycle, making sure outcomes are fair, well-reasoned and defensible.
  • Coaching senior leaders on their leadership, their teams and the conversations they'd rather avoid.
  • Using people data and insight to show leaders what's really happening in their organization and what to do about it.
  • Handling sensitive and high-risk matters with discretion and judgement, partnering with Employee Relations and Legal as needed.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including substantial time as a senior HR business partner supporting director, VP and executive-level leaders.
  • A track record of leading organizational design and change at scale, with measurable results you can point to.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, including when you're delivering a message they don't want to hear.
  • Sound judgement on complex employee relations and high-risk people matters.
  • Strong business and financial acumen. You're comfortable in a budget conversation and can hold your own with finance professionals.
  • Comfort using AI tools and people analytics to work faster and make better-informed recommendations.
  • Preferred: Experience supporting Finance or other corporate (G&A) functions, and with multi-country or multi-entity organizations, including international employment considerations.
  • Preferred: Exposure to M&A integration or large-scale restructuring, in tech,  or marketplace environments.

Benefits:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
  • 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
  • Subsidized commuter benefits
  • Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. title: Operations Associate - Flexdrive
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive, a subsidiary of Lyft provides vehicle access to Lyft drivers through a flexible car rental subscription program, is looking for a motivated and organized Operations Associate to join our Philadelphia team full-time. Reporting into the Operations Lead, in this role, you will be providing quality in-person experiences by serving customers at our local Flexdrive facilities that offer the Express Drive Program end-to-end rental process and preparing them for the exciting road ahead. If you love working with people, have a passion for operations and the thought of helping Lyft drivers continue to build this incredible ride-sharing movement in Philadelphia sounds exciting, we would love to meet you!  

Responsibilities:

  • Assists customers with the car rental process, including but not limited to Express Drive customer support, customer Arrival/Check-In, assigning drivers to rental vehicles and processing rental returns
  • Prepares Flexdrive rental vehicles for Lyft Drivers, which includes fueling and cleaning, installing telematics, license plates, conducting fleet vehicle inspections, and managing vehicle compliance documents
  • Manages vehicle lot organization, vehicle transportation, and other daily rental operations
  • Flags vehicle issues, program challenges, and bugs to the Operations Lead and internal/external partners

title: Data Curation Associate
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, we are building a more connected world, ride by ride. Whether it's an everyday commute or a journey that changes everything, we are driven by our purpose: to serve and connect. 

To create the best ride for all, we start in our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization where all team members are recognized for their input.

Data Curation Operations is a team which supports all ongoing curation projects for Mapping and other teams at Lyft. Our mission is to improve customer experience in Lyft products by providing high-quality, comprehensive, and efficient data curation operations. 

As a Data Curation Associate at Lyft, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, quality, and usability of Map Data. You will work closely with various teams to curate and maintain data sets that are essential for our operations and decision-making processes. We are looking for someone who has good analytical skills and is able to work with a large amount of information. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, like to solve challenging problems, and want to be part of the next big thing at Lyft, we would love to meet you!

Responsibilities:

  • Curate data sets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
  • Document data and tooling issues meticulously for analysis. Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
  • Accountability: Perform assigned tasks according to allocation, taking responsibility for assigned workload, expectations and timelines; understand and apply the goals, purposes and policies of the assigned projects.
  • Time management: Take responsibility for personal working time, effectively distributing and allocating work tasks and responsibilities throughout the day according to schedule guidelines.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate with colleagues while exchanging ideas, thoughts, opinions, knowledge, and data; demonstrate a willingness to help; share information with clarity, empathy, and understanding.
  • Curation tooling: Be proficient with the tools needed for performing duties and use them according to tooling guidelines and best practices (Google services, Self Service, Confluence, Jira, etc.). Learn quickly how to use internal mapping tools. Review Open Street Map (OSM) edits to ensure they are made in accordance with OSM and internal policies.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and integrity.

Expectations & Skills

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree or equivalent. Background in mapping, cartography, GIS and any related fields would be an advantage.
  • Strong computer skills: You must feel comfortable learning new processes, systems & tools, including labeling tools (data labeling, image labeling) and Google Drive products
  • Ability and readiness to deal with monotonous work without losing concentration
  • General understanding of traffic regulations and mapping fundamentals
  • Presence of basic logic, ability to handle ambiguity and provide independent reasoning and conclusions.
  • Strong personal communication skills. Good at asking questions, defending your point of view, and formulating thoughts. Team player. 
  • Ability to work in a distributed team remotely.
  • Proficiency in working with G-Suite products and services.
  • Customer obsessed: You are passionate about delivering great customer experiences with a strong track record to back that up. You have analytical and problem-solving skills to proactively address and prevent issues.
  • Self-directed and organized: You’re comfortable in a fast-paced environment and able to quickly adjust to changes in product direction and requirements. You know when to ask for support and you approach your work with a seize-the-day attitude. 
  • Strong and proactive communicator: You excel in verbal and written communication (English). You can adapt your communication style to work with team members from all corners of the organization, and you proactively share updates on processes you own. You are receptive to feedback and direction in order to successfully carry out tasks and lead projects to completion. 
  • Strong computer skills: You feel comfortable learning new processes, systems & tools, including labeling tools (data labeling, image labeling) and Google Workspace products.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with 3rd-party vendors will be an advantage
  • Experience using Open Street Map. 
  • Experience in the following or related fields: data entry, data labeling, quality control, processing and triaging feedback
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence

Please submit your resume in English.

title: Finance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

This Finance Analyst role will support our Rideshare business — the heart of Lyft’s operations — helping shape strategy, forecast performance, and guide critical decisions that impact millions of riders and drivers every day. We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with exceptional financial acumen and strategic thinking skills. Strong communication, prioritization, and teamwork are essential, along with a proactive, results-driven mindset.

This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in the financial future of one of the most innovative, mission-driven companies in the tech and mobility space.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and enhance financial models to assess performance, growth opportunities, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the weekly Actuals vs. Forecast process, identifying variances and updating Rest of Quarter projections to keep leadership informed of our trajectory.
  • Collaborate with teams across Operations and Product, to connect financial outcomes with business levers.
  • Enhance forecasting accuracy and reporting efficiency through automation and scalable tools.
  • Develop sustainable financial data management/sourcing practices 
  • Deliver clear, actionable insights through dashboards, reports, and executive presentations.
  • Ensure accurate and transparent financial reporting through collaboration with Accounting and Data teams
  • Support continuous improvement across FP&A systems and processes.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting team on month-end and quarter-end processes

Experience:

  • A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Finance) with at least 2-3 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, preferably in a dynamic and challenging environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop complex financial models, with excellent quantitative analysis and forecasting skills.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, accrual methodologies & reconciliations
  • Ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights that guide executive-level decision-making.
  • Proven capability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Comfort in dealing with ambiguity and the ability to derive insights from incomplete information.
  • A detail-oriented, highly organised self-starter with the ability to manage overlapping tasks and frequent priority changes.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of our finance processes and actively contribute to improving them, developing sustainable data management practices that allow the team to move fast.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in SQL and ERP systems, such as Oracle or Anaplan, is preferred.

Please submit your resume in English.

title: Software Engineer, Supply Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The SupplyPlatform team develops robust architectural platforms and foundational features to empower Lyft’s global growth. We are seeking a highly motivated software engineering professional to advance the platform infrastructure supporting autonomous vehicles, premium offerings, taxi integration, and international expansion. Ownership is a key quality for this team; this person should be driven to track a project to successful completion and beyond, taking initiative to work with other teams and functions to ensure the code they write reaches users and drives impact. 

As a Software Engineer for SupplyPlatform team, you’ll be responsible for enhancing the platform to support partner teams, making tradeoffs between technical investments and product work, and collaborating with other engineers on system design. title: ML Software Engineer, Routing
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Our transport network serves the needs of millions of people every day who want to get from one place to another using Lyft cars, bikes and scooters, or on foot in the most efficient way. To serve these needs, we need to suggest the fastest, most affordable and safest routes. 

We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Routing team. Our team builds and maintains Lyft's system responsible for providing routes for every ride request on our platform. We process millions of route requests per day and low latency, high reliability and high accuracy are paramount for our success. 

If you are a critical thinker with experience in machine learning workflows and writing reliable code, passionate about solving business problems using data and working in a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment, we are searching for you. 

Our technology stack runs on AWS, Kubernetes, Go, Python/C++, Apache Airflow, Flink, and Kafka. We use AI to improve development productivity, optimize customer support workflows, and enhance operational efficiency — all without compromising code quality or security. In this role, you will work with incredibly passionate and talented colleagues from software engineering, machine learning and data science on building rideshare experiences that delight millions of riders and drivers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Perform data analysis and build proof-of-concept to explore and compare ML and non-ML solutions
  • Be able to make effective tradeoffs between model accuracy, its productization complexity and runtime performance
  • Develop statistical, machine learning, or optimization models
  • Write production quality code that can scale well to serve millions of requests per day
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, production on-call support and incident triaging process.
  • Write well-crafted, well-tested, readable, maintainable code

Experience:

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or other quantitative fields or related work experience
  • 3+ years of Machine Learning experience
  • Nice-to-have: Experience with big data processing / distributed data pipelines and tools such as Apache Airflow and Spark/Flink
  • Proficiency in at least one of the SQL languages (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SqlServer, Oracle)
  • Ability to work in distributed teams spread across time zones. (EST and PST)

Benefits:

  • Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
  • RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

title: Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is building the safety capability for autonomous mobility. As Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs, you'll own key parts of Lyft's AV Safety Management System (SMS) across all four pillars: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. You'll also make sure the processes, documentation, and cross-functional machinery behind them work in practice.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of safety policy, program design, and cross-functional process support. You'll author policy, run risk and review cadences, turn safety data into decisions, and keep the Safety Review Board (SRB) running. You'll work closely with AV partners, and you can speak credibly about AV safety with technical counterparts, senior leaders, and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Safety Policy: Own Lyft's AV safety policy framework, safety procedures, and partner-facing governance documentation, including version control and periodic review cycles. Maintain governance charters, committee operating rhythms, and escalation protocols.
  • Safety Risk Management: Run hazard identification and risk assessment for AV operations and new launches. Maintain the operational risk register and track mitigations to closure.
  • Safety Assurance: Track safety performance indicators and trends, and surface emerging risks. Participate in incident and near-miss investigations and own corrective action (CAPA) tracking, so findings feed back into policy, operations, and partner work plans. Coordinate evidence and remediation for audits and certifications.
  • Safety Promotion: Drive safety communications, lessons-learned documentation, and training readiness.
  • Safety Review Board: Run the SRB cadence, including agendas, materials, decision records, and follow-through on action items.
  • Partner Engagement: Contribute to the standards and assessment frameworks Lyft uses with AV partners, and support partners' safety assurance and risk management activities.
  • Program Execution: Drive AV safety programs with safety leaders, including partners across EHS, Operations, Engineering, Legal, and others from inception through go-live. This includes safety readiness for new market launches and partner integrations.

Experience:

  • 4+ years supporting or managing safety management programs in a safety-critical transportation industry (AV, aviation, rail, automotive, trucking, or equivalent)
  • Working knowledge of SMS principles and how they apply to AV operations
  • Hands-on experience with risk assessment, incident follow-up, and corrective action tracking
  • Strong technical writing, including policy, procedures, and partner- or regulator-facing materials 
  • Comfort with safety data, including tracking indicators, spotting trends, and presenting findings to technical and senior audiences
  • Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder programs without direct authority
  • Bachelor's degree in safety, engineering, policy, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Nice to Have
    • Familiarity with AV safety frameworks (e.g., AVSC best practices) and US AV reporting requirements
    • Experience supporting robotaxi, ridehail, or fleet operations
    • Experience operating in a matrixed, partner-dependent environment where safety policy must be implemented through influence rather than direct control
    • Exposure to multi-market or international safety operations
