title: Senior Product Manager, Trust & Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco and New York offices.

Trust and Safety is at the core of Lyft’s business. Our work ensures that our drivers and riders are part of a trusted and trusting community. Lyft’s global expansion and the development of a hybrid platform (with autonomous vehicles driving side by side to drivers) are a unique opportunity to help us redefine how we deliver in our promise of safety. This is a highly cross functional role that will partner with our Growth organization to rethink how we support these partnerships.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build the future of the platform that supports Safety in our journey for global expansion, setting up an ambitious vision and roadmap that motivates and inspires your team, peers, and leadership, and that accounts for the uniqueness of our partners and community members.
  • Partner directly with engineering, data science, ML, design, and research teams to develop safety solutions uniquely tailored to each of our partners while maintaining a core platform that allows for speed of execution and maintainability.
  • Partner with Policy and Support teams to develop solutions that provide a cohesive experience to Drivers and Riders whenever they encounter issues when using Lyft.
  • Represent Trust and Safety as the SME in all our ongoing and new partnerships, ensuring that all new requirements are captured and well understood by the team.
  • Ability to conceptualize, manage and prioritize multiple projects for stakeholders
  • Define success metrics and drive data-informed decisions to ensure optimal prioritization

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with experience in Trust and Safety roles.
  • Deep technical acumen, with experience delivering platform solutions that accelerate integrations with third parties. Engineering or Computer Science Degree strongly preferred.
  • Experience leading a team of engineers and setting clear goals, strategies, and long term roadmaps.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape solutions as much as implement them.
  • Demonstrated impact working with internal and external partners, across cultures and working styles.

title: Engineering Manager, Lyft Business
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Business Travel team helps people who travel for work choose Lyft, and grows business travel as a line of business, one of Lyft’s growth priorities. Our customers include individual riders and the companies that offer Lyft as an employee benefit, so the work spans consumer and B2B products. Since launching Lyft Business Rewards in 2025, we’ve seen strong traction with business travelers. Next, we want to make Lyft the most rewarding and reliable way to travel for work.

The team includes back-end, web, iOS, and Android engineers and works closely with product management, design, and data science. Our work touches the core rider experience, so we partner closely with many teams across Lyft.

In this role you’ll lead the team and its roadmap. You’ll own planning and delivery with your PM partner, guide technical direction through design reviews, and coach engineers. We’re looking for an engineering manager with a solid software background and experience leading engineers, who has shipped consumer or B2B2C products alongside product, design, and data partners. title: Bid Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. This is a process and project coordination role rather than a content or strategy role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management.

Responsibilities: 

  • Bid Planning and Scheduling Support
    • Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. 
    • Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit.
    • Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early.
  • Tracking, Follow-Up, and Accountability
    • Track every deliverable, owner, and deadline across the bid team and contributing functions (Legal, Finance, Operations, Technical, Sales).
    • Send clear, timely reminders and follow up on outstanding inputs so contributions arrive on time and complete.
    • Escalate missed or at-risk deadlines to the Bid Manager promptly, with a clear summary of impact.
    • Maintain action and decision logs from bid meetings and make sure actions are closed out.
  • Tender Documentation and Compliance
    • Review tender documents on release and produce compliance matrices and requirement checklists.
    • Track customer clarification questions, responses, and addenda, and make sure changes are communicated to the team and reflected in the plan.
    • Run final compliance checks on formatting, page limits, mandatory forms, signatures, certifications, and attachments before submission.
    • Manage submission logistics on customer portals, including registration, uploads, and confirmation receipts.
  • Meeting and Review Coordination
    • Schedule and organize kickoff meetings, status meetings, and review sessions (e.g., color team reviews).
    • Prepare agendas, circulate materials in advance, capture notes, and distribute actions afterward.
    • Coordinate reviewer availability and consolidate review feedback for the Bid Manager.
  • Document and Content Management
    • Set up and manage bid folders, version control, and document naming conventions so the team always works from the latest version.
    • Coordinate the assembly, formatting, and production of final bid documents, working with designers or writers where needed.
    • Maintain the bid content library, templates, case studies, CVs, certifications, and standard company information, keeping them current and easy to find.
  • Pre-Tender and Pipeline Administration
    • Support the pre-tender and gate process by preparing gate review materials, tracking approvals, and recording bid/no-bid decisions.
    • Monitor tender portals and opportunity sources and log new opportunities in the pipeline tracker.
    • Keep pipeline and bid reporting accurate, including status, key dates, and outcomes.
  • Process Improvement and Lessons Learned
    • Help embed consistent bid processes, templates, and checklists across all pursuits.
    • Organize post-submission and win/loss debriefs, record lessons learned, and track improvement actions.
    • Suggest practical improvements to tools and ways of working based on what is and isn't working.

Experience: 

  • 2–4 years of experience in a coordination, project support, bid/proposal support, or administrative role in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities at once.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a methodical approach to tracking and checking work.
  • Confident, professional communicator who is comfortable following up with colleagues at all levels, including senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace (especially Excel/Sheets and Word/Docs) and comfort with project tracking tools.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience supporting public sector or formal procurement tenders.
    • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, Jira) and e-procurement portals.
    • APMP Foundation certification or project coordination training (e.g., CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation), or interest in pursuing one.
    • Basic document formatting or design skills.

Benefits: 

  • Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Pet benefits
  • Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
  • RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service 
  • Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
  • Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

title: Coordonnateur des appels d'offres
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Le coordonnateur ou la coordonnatrice des appels d'offres est la pierre angulaire de l'équipe. En collaboration avec les responsables et les spécialistes des appels d'offres, il/elle veille à ce que chaque appel d'offres suive un processus rigoureux et bien géré, garantissant ainsi le respect des délais, la clarté des attentes pour chaque contributeur et l'absence d'oublis. Ce poste est axé sur la coordination des processus et des projets, et non sur la stratégie ou le contenu. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) est une personne très organisée, minutieuse et proactive : capable de structurer des situations complexes, de gérer simultanément de nombreux éléments et d'assurer le suivi auprès de ses collègues au sein de l'entreprise pour assurer la progression des projets. Ce poste représente un excellent tremplin pour une personne souhaitant évoluer dans le domaine de la gestion des appels d'offres.

Responsabilités: 

  • Soutien à la planification et à l'ordonnancement des appels d'offres
    • Fournir du soutien aux gestionnaires d'appels d'offres dans l'élaboration de plans d'action à rebours à partir de la date de soumission, y compris les étapes clés, les phases de validation, les échéances internes et les marges de sécurité.
    • Créer et tenir à jour les outils de suivi, les calendriers et les matrices de responsabilités (par exemple, RACI) pour chaque appel d'offres.
    • Veiller à ce que les plans soient mis à jour en fonction des changements d'échéancier et signaler rapidement au responsable de l'appel d'offres tout risque lié au calendrier.
  • Aide à la planification et à l'ordonnancement des appels d'offres
    • Appuyer les gestionnaires d'appels d'offres dans l'élaboration de plans de soumission structurés à rebours à partir de la date de dépôt, incluant les étapes clés, les phases de validation, les échéances internes et les marges de sécurité.
    • Mettre en place et tenir à jour les outils de suivi, les calendriers et les matrices de responsabilités (par exemple, RACI) pour chaque appel d'offres.
    • Veiller à ce que les plans soient mis à jour en fonction des changements d'échéancier et signaler rapidement au responsable de l'appel d'offres tout risque lié au calendrier.
  • Suivi, relance et responsabilisation
    • Assurez le suivi de chaque livrable, responsable et échéance au sein de l'équipe d'appel d'offres et des fonctions associées (juridique, finances, opérations, technique, ventes).
    • Envoyez des rappels clairs et opportuns et assurez un suivi des contributions manquantes afin qu'elles soient complètes et reçues dans les délais.
    • Signalez rapidement au gestionnaire de l'appel d'offres tout retard ou risque d'échéance, en fournissant un résumé clair de l'impact.
    • Conservez un compte rendu des actions et des décisions prises lors des réunions d'appel d'offres et assurez-vous de leur clôture.
  • Documentation d'appel d'offres et conformité
    • Examiner les documents d'appel d'offres dès leur publication et établir des matrices de conformité et des listes de contrôle des exigences.
    • Assurer le suivi des questions, réponses et addenda des clients, et veiller à ce que
      les modifications soient communiquées à l'équipe et intégrées au plan.
    • Effectuer les derniers contrôles de conformité (formatage, nombre de pages, formulaires obligatoires, signatures, certifications et pièces jointes) avant soumission.
    • Gérer la logistique des soumissions sur les portails clients : inscription, téléchargements et accusés de réception.
  • Coordination des réunions et des examens
    • Planifiez et organisez des réunions de lancement, des réunions de statut et des séances de révision (par exemple, révisions de l'équipe couleur).
    • Préparez les ordres du jour, faites circuler les documents à l'avance, prenez des notes et distribuez les actions par la suite.
    • Coordonner la disponibilité des réviseurs et consolider les commentaires des réviseurs pour Bid Manager.
  • Gestion des documents et du contenu
    • Configurez et gérez les dossiers d'offres, le contrôle de version et les conventions de nommage des documents afin que l'équipe travaille toujours à partir de la dernière version.
    • Coordonner l'assemblage, le formatage et la production des documents d'appel d'offres finaux, en travaillant avec des concepteurs ou des rédacteurs si nécessaire.
    • Tenez à jour la bibliothèque de contenu des offres, les modèles, les études de cas, les CV, les certifications et les informations standard sur l'entreprise, en les gardant à jour et faciles à trouver.
  • Administration préalable aux appels d'offres et aux pipelines
    • Soutenir le processus de pré-appel d'offres et de validation en préparant les documents d'examen, en assurant le suivi des approbations et en consignant les décisions de soumission/refus.
    • Surveiller les portails d'appel d'offres et les sources d'opportunités et consigner les nouvelles opportunités dans l'outil de suivi.
    • Assurer l'exactitude des rapports relatifs aux appels d'offres et aux projets en cours, y compris leur statut, les dates clés et les résultats.
  • Amélioration des processus et des leçons apprises
    • Contribuer à l'harmonisation des processus, des modèles et des listes de contrôle des appels d'offres pour l'ensemble des projets.
    • Organiser des bilans post-soumission et de résultats (gains/échecs), consigner les leçons apprises et suivre les mesures d'amélioration.
    • Proposer des améliorations concrètes des outils et des méthodes de travail en fonction de leurs forces et de leurs points faibles.

Expérience: 

  • 2 à 4 ans d'expérience en coordination, soutien de projet, assistance à la rédaction d'appels d'offres,
  • ou en administration, dans un environnement dynamique où les délais sont serrés.
  • Excellentes compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps, avec une capacité avérée à gérer plusieurs échéances et priorités simultanément.
  • Souci exceptionnel du détail et approche méthodique du suivi et du contrôle des tâches.
  • Communication assurée et professionnelle, avec aisance relationnelle avec des collègues de tous les niveaux, y compris les parties prenantes de haut niveau.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Office ou Google Workspace (notamment Excel/Sheets et Word/Docs) et maîtrise des outils de suivi de projet.
  • Baccalauréat ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
  • Préféré:
    • Expérience en matière d'assistance aux appels d'offres du secteur public ou des marchés publics formels.
    • Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet (par exemple, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, Jira) et des plateformes d'e-procurement.
    • Certification APMP Foundation ou formation en coordination de projet (par exemple, CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation), ou intérêt pour l'obtention de ces certifications.
    • Compétences de base en mise en page et conception de documents.

Avantages:

  • Excellente couverture d’assurance santé, dentaire, vision, ainsi que l’assurance vie et prestation d’invalidité
  • Programme de soutien en santé mentale
  • Soutien à la fertilité et à la planification familiale
  • Avantage pour les soins d'animaux de compagnie
  • Compte de dépenses de santé (HSA)
  • Options de cotisation pour le REER
  • En plus des jours fériés observés dans la province, les membres salariés de l’équipe sont couverts par la politique flexible de congés payés de Lyft. La politique permet aux membres de l’équipe de prendre autant de temps qu’ils en ont besoin (avec l’approbation du gestionnaire). Les membres de l’équipe payés à l’heure bénéficient de 15 jours de congés payés, avec un jour supplémentaire pour chaque année de service
  • Lyft est fier de soutenir les nouveaux parents avec 18 semaines de congés payés, conçu comme une complémentarité aux programmes gouvernementaux. Les parents biologiques, adoptifs et adoptifs sont tous élus.
  • Avantage lié au transport

title: Social Media Team Lead (Overnight)
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Social Media, ON Team Lead is responsible for driving exceptional outcomes for our customers by ensuring that our social media overnight team is consistently achieving their goals. They lead and manage their team, providing strategic direction, ongoing coaching, data analysis, project management, and overseeing daily operations. This role includes leading, supervising, presenting, cross functional work, communication, and more. 

The Team Lead is a strong leader and figurehead for their team. They are a key resource for the overnight team. They handle escalations, answer associate questions, and share critical updates. The Team Lead proactively identifies opportunities for continuous operational improvement through root cause analysis, deep dives into tickets or data, and shadowing interactions. Based on these insights, they collaborate with cross-functional partners and dayside team leads to implement both short-term and long-term solutions to enhance overall customer outcomes. They are also willing to flex into certain dayside meetings in order to present out findings and insight to senior management. 

The ideal candidate is passionate about leadership and driving results and improvement on their team. They are empathetic, compassionate, and capable of leading in a fast paced, ambiguous environment. They is highly organized, focused, and thrives in a fast-paced work environment. They excel in navigating ambiguity and are exceptional at root cause analysis, continuous improvement, clear communication, flexibility, leadership, and team building. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead shoulder to shoulder to deliver outstanding results, driving shared outcomes measured through key performance indicators such as SLA, CSAT, TAR, QAR scores, and beyond.
  • Lead a team of associates to provide a world-class customer experience by offering continuous support, coaching, development, and mentorship in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and foster a culture of excellence and growth.
  • Take proactive ownership of the customer experience across various social media platforms, ensuring that customer interactions are handled with the highest level of care and professionalism.

title: Senior Manager, Global Workforce Planning
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft's Customer Care Operations team handles more than 1.7 million customer interactions every month. We support riders, drivers, and businesses across voice, chat, and messaging, through in-house teams and a global network of outsourced partners.

As Senior Manager, Global Workforce & Partner Management, you'll own how our global workforce is sized, scheduled, funded, and protected. You'll turn demand into capacity, manage the spend behind it, and own the business relationship with our outsourced partners. You'll work hand in hand with the Support Operations leaders who own service delivery and quality, giving them the plans, insights, and partner capacity they need to deliver for customers. Reporting to the Director, Global Strategy & Operations, you'll lead Forecasting, Financial Planning & Management, and Workforce Management, including Scheduling & Real-Time Operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan the workforce. Own short- and long-range forecasting and capacity planning across channels, queues, languages, and lines of business. Lock and deliver rolling billable hour forecasts to our partners, so they can staff accurately and we can hold them accountable to the plan. Build the models behind our annual and half-year plans, and stress-test them as the business and AI adoption evolve.
  • Hold teams accountable to the plan. Make sure in-house and partner teams staff to the forecast, schedule to requirements, and keep agents adherent and productive. Own forecast accuracy, staffing to plan, schedule adherence, occupancy, and shrinkage.
  • Manage the queues. Monitor handle time, resolution time, and wait times in real time. When wait times degrade or a mass defect hits, lead urgent queue management to protect customers.
  • Give leadership clear visibility. Set the goals, scorecards, and business reviews that show how we're performing on staffing, cost, and partner health. Develop and communicate concise, evidence-based narratives for leadership.
  • Own workforce spend. Manage the Customer Care workforce budget with Finance across both internal and outsourced agents. Track cost per contact and the drivers behind it, such as headcount, overtime, and utilization. Govern partner billing end to end, including billable hours, rate structures, invoice accuracy, and performance-based credits.
  • Own the partner business relationship. Manage the commercial side of our BPO partnerships, including contracts, governance cadences, executive business reviews, and commercial escalations. Partner with Procurement on new agreements and renewals.
  • Be a trusted partner to Support Operations. Work alongside the support operations leaders who own service delivery and quality, so their customer goals and KPIs are met. Surface the insights that move productivity, wait times, and customer experience, and turn them into action together.
  • Shape our footprint and resilience. Influence where work is done and by whom, including vendor allocation, site strategy, and location mix. Plan and test business continuity so capacity can shift quickly when disruptions hit.
  • See around corners. Serve as Customer Care's primary point of contact with Product, Tech, and business leaders on what's changing across Lyft, from ride volume and AI improvements to launches, global growth, integrations, and new partnerships. Size and scope the support impact early so we're staffed, funded, and ready from day one.
  • Make the case for investment. Size opportunities, articulate trade-offs, and build the business cases that fund strategic priorities.
  • Build a best-in-class function. Get the most out of our workforce management tools and tech stack. Automate manual work, improve data and reporting, and make planning faster and more accurate.
  • Build the team, inside and out. Hire, develop, and lead a team of managers and analysts, with clear ownership across a function where finance, operations, and technology meet. Extend that leadership to the workforce teams at our outsourced partners by setting clear goals for productivity, staffing, and scheduling.

Experience:

  • 10+ years in contact center workforce management, support operations, or operations strategy, including 5+ years leading managers.
  • A track record of owning workforce planning for a large, global, multi-channel, multi-language operation with both in-house and outsourced teams.
  • Expert command of workforce execution metrics, including forecast accuracy, staffing to plan, adherence, occupancy, shrinkage, handle time, and wait time. You know how to hold in-house and partner teams accountable to them and how to stabilize queues quickly when things go wrong.
  • Experience owning the commercial relationship with BPO partners at enterprise scale, including contracts, billing models, footprint, and site decisions.
  • A strong financial foundation. You've owned a workforce budget across internal and outsourced agents, managed cost per contact, and can turn capacity models into a clear story for Finance and senior leadership.
  • Experience leading through influence, both with support operations leaders whose goals you help deliver and with partner teams you don't directly manage.
  • Experience sizing the support impact of growth, launches, integrations, or new partnerships, ideally in a marketplace or platform business.
  • Experience building business continuity plans across multiple vendors and regions.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise WFM tools, plus a builder's mindset for automating manual work and improving data and reporting.
  • Practical AI fluency. You understand how automation changes demand, staffing, and partner economics, and you can lead teams through that shift.
  • You're a trusted partner to Finance, Product, Tech, and Operations, and you're clear, direct, and decisive.

title: Senior Product Designer, Mapping
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.

We obsess over questions like: did your pickup spot feel safe and convenient? Did your driver feel confident following the route and arriving on the correct side of the road? Did you get stuck in unexpected traffic or road closures? You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences. 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to advocate and maintain a user-obsessed culture within Lyft, and be happy and comfortable in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You'll partner with designers, researchers, marketers, and product managers to define and create top-notch experiences with safety as a core tenet for success. You’re experienced with every step of product development, from brainstorming broad ideas to ensure design quality through launch. Using your full range of interaction, visual, and product thinking skills, you will lead and own core Mapping experiences across our product teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Own core experiences end to end. Lead design for Mapping's most important user-facing surfaces, from problem definition through launch and iteration. Your primary areas, in order of focus:
    • Core Navigation – turn-by-turn guidance, map zoom and motion details, and how drivers orient themselves with the road
    • Real-time Feedback and Voice AI – how drivers report what's happening on the road, including emerging voice and AI-assisted experiences
    • Map styling and 3D views – the visual language of the map itself, including 3D and map assets
    • Map Tooling – internal tools that help Lyft's mapping and operations teams keep the map accurate
  • Drive cross-organizational alignment. Proactively reach across organizational boundaries to partner with cross-functional leaders, synthesize competing feedback, and build consensus around complex design decisions.
  • Work at the systems level. Build reusable design-system components, tooling, and map assets that improve the platform as well as individual features, so every surface built on the map gets better.
  • Hold a high quality bar. Benchmark Lyft's map and navigation experiences against the leading map products, and use that bar to raise the quality of what we ship.
  • Support accurate implementation. Partner closely with engineering and content design through build, edge cases, and launch, so what ships matches what was designed.
  • Lead through ambiguity. Take complex, loosely defined problems, work with product and engineering leads to frame them, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.
  • Raise the work (and work-ers) around you. Give critique that improves others' work, communicate complex design decisions clearly to broad audiences, including leadership, and help shape how the team works.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of complex, shipped mobile experiences
  • Experience designing maps, navigation, or location-based products
  • Strong craft in interaction and visual design, and the ability to prototype at high fidelity to explore and communicate ideas
  • Strong advocate and experimental mindset with AI-native prototyping and tooling, whether code-based, AI-assisted, or both
  • Upholds Design+ quality: Confidently interprets and applies UX Standards (Accessibility, Safety, Reliability, Usability, and Lyft Product Language) to work
  • A proactive mindset driving cross-team collaboration, self-directed in ambiguity, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback across all levels
  • A track record of systems-level work: design-system components, reusable patterns, tooling, or assets adopted beyond a single feature
  • Close, effective partnership with product, engineering, data science and content design, including owning the details through implementation
  • A rigorous quality bar, informed by deep familiarity with the best and most innovative map and navigation products
  • Clear communication of complex, ambiguous work to broad groups and senior stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Motion design and 3D experience, especially for maps, animated components, and real-time interfaces
  • Voice or conversational UI design experience
  • Experience with driver, logistics, in-vehicle, or other high-stakes, glanceable interfaces
  • Experience designing internal tools for operations or data teams

title: Data Scientist, Algorithms - Pricing - Rider Engagement
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. Data Scientists at Lyft operate in a dynamic environment, and partner closely with cross-functional teammates to tackle a variety of highly open-ended business problems to build the world’s best transportation solutions.

The Pricing team is a centerpiece of Lyft’s marketplace, determining prices for all rideshare products and supporting new initiatives, and Rider Engagement is an integral part of that. Rider Engagement manages one of the most impactful marketplace and business levers, driving both short term and long term business outcomes. The team owns the algorithms and systems behind incentive offers, budget management, operational control and real-time optimization.

We are looking for fast learning, data-driven individuals who are passionate about tackling these open-ended problems in pricing theory and making a large, positive impact in the business. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering and Analytics on a cross-functional team to develop and iterate incentive levers, prototype and build end-to-end solutions that can operate at scale. In addition, you will be expected to leverage your domain knowledge and influence existing and future roadmaps to help Lyft continue to deliver a better experience for riders and drivers.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with other Scientists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Business Partners to frame problems mathematically and within the business context
  • Write production code. Collaborate with Software Engineers to implement algorithms in live systems and ensure the robustness of the systems
  • Develop and fit statistical, machine learning, or optimization models. Deploy production-grade models that solve business problems.
  • Design, implement, and analyse different types of experiments, and facilitate data-driven and informed decision making and prioritization
  • Establish metrics and development measurement methodologies to monitor the health of our products, as well as the impacts on user and marketplace outcomes
  • Perform deep dive analysis to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and uncover new product and business opportunities
  • Drive collaboration and coordination with cross-functional teams. Communicate findings to a broad audience consisting of Product, Engineering, and executive leadership.

Experience:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science or other quantitative fields
  • 1-4+ years professional experience for PhDs or 3-5+ years for Master’s in a Data Science role in a technology company setting
  • Proven experience with building and evaluating optimization or machine learning models
  • Proficiency with Python and working in a production coding environment
  • Passion for solving unstructured and non-standard mathematical problems

title: Associate Counsel, Employment
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a bright, pragmatic, and self-motivated employment attorney with 4+ years of employment counseling and litigation experience to join our growing global Legal team. The ideal candidate will leverage their prior law firm and/or in-house experience to provide thoughtful, timely, practical and business-minded legal advice primarily to the professionals on Lyft’s Employee Relations and People teams across the globe. You must have experience litigating and/or counseling on compliance with federal and state anti-discrimination/harassment/retaliation laws, preferably including analysis of issues under California law. Prior in-house or seconded technology company experience is preferred but not required. The successful candidate will be an entrepreneurial and resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, excellent at building strong relationships and interested in learning more about supporting a global workforce.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide pragmatic day-to-day employment advice and counseling on a broad range of employment issues in order to balance business impact and legal risk including HR practices, performance management, terminations, leaves of absence, investigations, and employee accommodations.
  • Investigate pre-litigation and litigation matters.  Develop and implement strategies for early resolution (as appropriate) and work with outside counsel as appropriate.
  • Provide guidance and Interpret policies and procedures, incorporating knowledge of state and federal employment laws (e.g., FMLA, ADA, FLSA, NLRA, and Title VII and equivalent state and international laws).
  • Provide legal counsel and support to a global workforce.
  • Partner closely with Lyft’s Employee Relations and People team professionals on employee complaints and investigations, performance management, and accommodations.
  • Collaborate with other members of the Employment Legal Team and People Team to develop strong processes to ensure compliance with applicable state, federal and local laws.
  • Develop and deliver training to managers and employees -- candidates must be comfortable with public speaking.
  • Monitor important developments in employment law in jurisdictions across the country and internationally, striving to spot trends in their infancy.
  • Work and build trust with cross-functional partners from teams across the Legal Department and the Company.
  • Travel from time-to-time as necessary to service internal clients; develop cross-office relationships; and attend legal proceedings/negotiations.\

Experience:

  • 4+ years practicing employment law at a leading law firm and/or in-house, with experience and/or interest in advice and counseling
  • Prior in-house experience and expertise supporting a global workforce is a plus but not required.
  • Active and in good standing with a State Bar and eligible to practice in the relevant jurisdiction where you are located. 
  • J.D. from a top-tier law school

  • Resourceful self-starter and have a passion for results. Embody Lyft’s culture, and operate with high standards and ethics

title: Counsel, Patents & IP
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

This position will manage Lyft's patent function — driving the strategy and day-to-day management of our patent portfolio — while also advising on the company's approach to open source, reviewing technical publications before they go external, and serving as a trusted advisor on IP questions across the business. This position will report to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, IP. Beyond the legal chops, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships — you'll spend as much time with engineers and researchers as you will with lawyers, so a warm, curious, low-ego style goes a long way here. We value people who can make patent law feel approachable rather than intimidating, who bring a sense of humor to a fast-moving environment, and who are as excited about celebrating an inventor's first disclosure as they are about closing out a tricky filing decision. This is a great opportunity for someone to come in and manage the patent function at Lyft, working on cutting-edge issues spanning Lyft's global expansion, Lyft Urban Solutions' mobility hardware and software business, and supporting the deployment and expansion of autonomous vehicles on Lyft's network.

title: Fleet Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission. 

About Flexdrive

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a leader in fleet management and a Lyft subsidiary, we're extending our expertise into autonomous vehicle (AV) infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep AV fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. Our Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion, and we're building the team to sustain and scale it.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Deployment, Flexdrive is seeking an experienced and safety-focused Operations Lead to manage afternoon shift operations and ensure comprehensive safety compliance for our 24/7 AV depot in Nashville. This critical role bridges operational excellence with rigorous safety standards, serving as the primary on-shift leader responsible for team management, incident response, and maintaining compliance with all partner and regulatory requirements. You will be the guardian of operational safety and efficiency, ensuring every shift meets or exceeds our stringent safety and performance standards.

This role requires a unique combination of operational leadership, safety expertise, and the ability to manage complex compliance requirements while maintaining high team performance. If you excel at leading teams in safety-critical environments and can balance operational demands with unwavering safety standards, we encourage you to apply.

Work Schedule & Shift Availability:

Day Window Shift Pattern

  • This role supports 24/7 AV depot operations and requires availability to work day shifts, with hours scheduled between 12:00 PM - 11:00 PM. 
  • Schedules will include weekends and holidays based on depot operational requirements.
  • Specific shift times and schedules will be determined based on operational needs and business requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Shift Leadership & Team Management:

    • 24/7 Operational Command: Lead and oversee all depot operations during assigned shifts, managing team performance, task allocation, and workflow optimization to meet fleet availability targets and SLAs.
    • Personnel Development: Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and coaching sessions while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and safety-first mindset across all team members.
    • Real-Time Staff Management: Maintain real-time updates of staff availability, coordinate shift handovers, and ensure adequate coverage for all critical depot functions including cleaning, charging, calibration, and maintenance support.
    • Escalation Management: Serve as primary escalation point for urgent operational issues, coordinating with partner support teams for fleet-wide events, safety incidents, or disruptions affecting three or more vehicles.

    Safety Compliance & Risk Management:

    • Safety Program Implementation: Implement Safety Risk Management Program aligned with partner requirements, including hazard identification, risk assessment, and mitigation strategies.
    • EHS Compliance Leadership: Ensure all depot operations meet OSHA, EPA, and partner-specific EHS standards, including implementing 30+ safety programs from hazardous materials handling to emergency response protocols.
    • Incident Response Command: Lead incident response within 30-minute SLA, conducting root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions (CAPA), and submitting preliminary reports within 24 hours per partner standards.
    • Regulatory Compliance: Maintain documented compliance with all AV regulatory requirements, coordinating with local, state, and federal authorities while ensuring all reporting obligations are met.

    Training & Quality Assurance:

    • Training Compliance Oversight: Ensure all personnel maintain active qualifications per partner requirements, tracking monthly verification of training status through the partner's learning management system.
    • Safety Training Delivery: Coordinate and deliver safety-specific training including Emergency Action Plan (EAP) drills, hazmat handling, and role-specific safety protocols.
    • Quality Monitoring: Conduct regular compliance audits of standard operating procedures (SOPs), implement quality control measures, and maintain a tiered documentation system for all safety and operational records.
    • Continuous Improvement: Analyze safety performance indicators (SPIs), identify trends, and implement process improvements to enhance both safety and operational efficiency.

    Operational Excellence & Communication:

    • Performance Management: Monitor and optimize KPIs including vehicle uptime, task cycle times, fleet utilization, and safety metrics while maintaining detailed shift reports and handover documentation.
    • Vendor Coordination: Manage relationships with third-party service providers, ensuring all vendors meet partner safety and compliance standards during depot operations.
    • Emergency Preparedness: Maintain and execute Emergency Action Plans (EAP), conduct annual drills, and ensure all personnel are trained on emergency procedures and evacuation protocols.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Interface with partner support teams, coordinate with other shift leads, and ensure seamless 24/7 operational continuity through effective communication and documentation.

Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in operational management roles within safety-critical environments (transportation, logistics, automotive, or manufacturing preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience in safety management, EHS compliance, or risk management with demonstrated success implementing safety programs in 24/7 operations.
  • Proven track record of leading teams in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments while maintaining strict safety and quality standards.
  • Demonstrated expertise in regulatory compliance, audit management, and maintaining documentation for compliance verification.
  • Strong understanding of fleet operations, vehicle maintenance workflows, and logistics management in multi-shift environments.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and ensuring third-party compliance with operational and safety standards.
  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to interface with multiple stakeholders, from frontline staff to executive leadership and regulatory bodies.
  • Required certifications: Valid driver's license with clean driving record; OSHA 30-hour certification preferred or willingness to obtain within 90 days

Benefits:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
  • 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
  • Subsidized commuter benefits
  • Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

descriptionHtml:

You’ll sit on the Social & Culture team and will be the owner of influencer at Lyft across critical initiatives. This role is for you if you can spot a viral creator on Monday, close the deal on Tuesday, then launch on Wednesday—and turn the relationship into something we can ignite again in a month. 

You’ll work in close partnership with our Global Growth, Brand, Product Marketing, Legal, and Business Affairs teams, as well as our creator agency partners and production teams. This role requires sharp talent instincts, real deal-making experience, a deep rolodex, and a creative strategic eye for the right influencers to really make campaigns pop.

  • Own creator agency relationship for XFN support across key NNIs, including always-on and campaign programs

  • Build the repeatable process: intake, talent vetting, rate benchmarking, brief templates, and measurement standards for both organic and paid work

title: Senior Product Manager, Rider ML/AI
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Rider Recommendations team is an Applied AI and Machine Learning team tasked with personalizing all realtime decisions happening inside the Rider Apps, including search, ride modes, content selection and ranking, message generation and others. Since last year, this team has been one of the major contributors to financial outcomes at Lyft and, working closely with the Rider App team, they are in the process of evolving the Rider application to make more room for personalization and realtime decision making. The team operates as the orchestration layer behind everything that the rider sees, being the final decision maker on what to show.

You will work closely with machine learning, AI engineers and data scientists to define the right objectives for the team’s models, interfacing with the rest of the company to understand the Rider App’s stakeholder teams needs and Lyft’s overall goals. In order to do this, you will have to identify the outcomes worth pursuing and translate them into a single objective to be used end to end by the applications. You’ll have to consider short term and long term tradeoffs, other than objectives of partner teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, own and be responsible for the roadmap of applied ML and AI products in every screen of the Rider Application, through the Rider conversion funnel
  • Define, track and periodically report on metrics and KPIs of the team, being directly responsible for financial outcomes that the team drives
  • Define the objective function to be maximized / minimized throughout the rider app, taking into account short term, long term and stakeholder teams’ objectives (Loyalty, Partnership, Ads, Business, AV, Safety, Luxury etc)
  • Work with data science to define, measure and predict long term value of Riders
  • Identify how to cold start new launches of region, modes and features in order to effectively drive adoption while still maintaining algorithm performance
  • Work in a cross functional team building a unified Rider profile vision by identifying, collecting and organizing information about Riders to be used for ML and AI training
  • Write detailed product requirements, strategy and planning documents aimed at both technical and non technical audiences to drive alignment on product development, set expectations on delivery of milestones and create predictable outcomes for workstreams
  • Design, run and analyze experiments and ongoing evaluation systems to monitor model performance and evaluate improvements
  • Present to non technical leadership on the progress of the team monthly, showcasing progress and highlighting roadblocks

Experience:

  • Experience driving technically complex machine learning (ML) products end to end, from inception, to launch with significant user adoption, to sunset. Ideally the applications are consumer facing and involve UI interactions with users
  • Experience in managing (from product perspective) a team of software engineers, tracking the progress towards a roadmap through appropriate tools (Jira, Linear, Spreadsheets, Clickup etc)
  • Experience with user facing large scale experimentation (optimizely, statsig, eppo etc), knowing concepts such as power and statistical significance
  • Experience in using AI agents to accelerate day to day execution including, amongst others, to: understand code, perform queries on company data, prepare dashboards for leadership
  • Knowledge of how machine learning and AI work, including of the most widely known machine learning and deep learning packages (xgboost, catboost, lightgbm, scikit learn, keras, pytorch etc), other than the autoresearch approach
  • Familiarity with crafting and leading presentations to small groups at the CXO executive level and to big teams (100+ ppl) at an all hands like level in medium to large companies
  • Ability to review and provide critical product feedback to technical specifications written by engineers
  • Ease in driving results and operating independently and with little supervision in flat structured organizations where approvals are not needed but results are closely monitored

title: Staff Product Manager I, Base Pricing
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.

Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.

The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.

The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.

Responsibilities: 

As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:

  • Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)
  • Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions
  • Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices
  • Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio 
  • Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams
  • Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles
  • Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.
  • Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of product management or relevant experience, with significant time spent on algorithmic, data-driven, pricing, or marketplace products
  • A deep technical understanding of microeconomics, and ideally a background in Operations Research, Econometrics, Machine Learning, or algorithmic systems
  • Experience owning pricing, revenue management, or other economic levers with direct P&L impact; experience with price optimization, elasticity modeling, or cost modeling is a strong plus
  • Experience running A/B tests and market-level experiments, using statistical and causal inference techniques to evaluate results, and developing post-launch testing strategies
  • Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design
  • Ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products, and excellent judgment about the dynamics of a product ecosystem
  • Natural ability to make things happen around you; you manage ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies across many teams in an organized and structured way
  • Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level — within teams, within the company, and with executives
  • Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation

title: Internal Communications Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is seeking a seasoned Internal Communications leader to set and own communications strategy for key areas of the business. This person will be a trusted advisor to senior leaders and a go-to communications expert on business priorities. They'll bring those leaders' priorities company-wide through narratives that deliver on our business objectives and further our purpose, vision, and values.

Lyft is telling a transformation story about global growth, and we aim to deliver strategies that enable our teams to move at lightning speed. Great communications create focus and alignment, so teams spend less time resolving confusion and more time executing with clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making. To be successful in this role, this individual will allocate their efforts as follows:

  • 30% Strategy: Independently identify high-impact opportunities and set the communications roadmap that moves the business forward.
  • 40% Rhythm of the Business: Lead execution of communications strategies and programs.
  • 30% Unexpected: Lead rapid response, crisis communications, and change management.

We're looking for someone who earns the trust of senior leaders quickly, brings a point of view, and isn't afraid to push back. This individual should be a strategic thinker and a strong writer, comfortable moving between the big picture and the details, and energized by ambiguity. Most importantly, Lyft is about fostering an open, inclusive, and diverse community where all team members are recognized for what they bring, and we want you to be you.

This role will report directly to Leslie Zodikoff as a member of the Internal Communications team and part of our Team Member Experience Team, which rolls into our People organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and own an annual communications roadmap for designated areas of the business, connecting communications to business objectives and measuring impact against clear outcomes.
  • Serve as a key advisor to senior leaders on communications strategy and execution, influencing what is communicated, when, and how.
  • Become the go-to communications expert on the business areas you support, with a deep understanding of their roadmap, challenges, and priorities.
  • Lead large, complex, multi-quarter communications programs that span multiple teams and functions, motivating partners to take ownership and staying aligned with business priorities.
  • Craft high-level, clear messaging for executive leaders and company-wide distribution.
  • Lead communications response for complex, multi-stakeholder situations, including crisis and change management.
  • Anticipate communications challenges and proactively develop solutions to address them before they arise.
  • Use data and industry insights to inform strategy, and continuously improve how we communicate.
  • Set high standards for communications quality, and support the growth of others on the team through mentorship and feedback.
  • Maintain the Lyft brand and voice across all communications, written and verbal.

Experience:

  • Proven track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives

  • Ability to fluidly navigate between strategy and execution, from developing strategic plans to producing crisp, clear communications
  • Experience leading communications through crisis and significant organizational change
  • Experience communicating complex business, product, or technology topics in a way that resonates with a broad audience
  • Experience tailoring communications to distributed and global workforces, including full-time and hourly team members
  • A clear point of view on how AI can improve communications effectiveness, and experience putting it into practice

title: Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing
descriptionHtml:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. 

The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. This role brings together commercial strategy, business intelligence, demand planning, and bid management in one function. Working as a strategic partner and deputy to the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, the Bid Director owns the full pursuit lifecycle, from market strategy and pre-tender capture through bid submission and handover to delivery. We're looking for a strategist who is equally strong commercially, technically, and financially, and who leads people and cross-functional teams with confidence.

Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.

Responsibilities:

Commercial Strategy, Business Intelligence, and Demand Planning

  • Shape the commercial strategy with the Head of Commercial Strategy & Delivery, including target markets, regions of focus, and growth priorities.
  • Lead the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager across planning, pricing policy, business intelligence, and demand planning.
  • Build business and bid intelligence (market, customer, competitor, and procurement insight) that drives strategy, pipeline, and pursuit decisions.
  • Own demand planning and pipeline forecasting, aligning bid capacity and resources with expected opportunities and revenue targets.

Pre-Tender, Capture, and Bid/No-Bid

  • Own a gated process that all pre-tender pursuits follow, aligned with commercial strategy and target regions.
  • Deliver capture plans for strategic and specific pursuits, shaping opportunities well before tender release.
  • Own bid/no-bid recommendations, presenting a clear view of strategic fit, path to win, risk, and financial return to senior leadership.

Bid Strategy and Execution

  • Frame each bid to win: set win themes, value proposition, competitive discriminators, and pricing position at kickoff.
  • Shape solutions and commercial offers with Operations, Technical, Finance, and Legal so they are competitive, deliverable, and profitable.
  • Build and challenge bid financial models, pricing, and business cases, ensuring every bid meets agreed margin thresholds.
  • Embed disciplined bid planning, with clear milestones, review gates, owners, and deadlines.

Leadership and Partnership

  • Lead and develop a team of Bid Managers, Bid Specialists, Bid Coordinators, and the Commercial Strategy & Demand Planning Manager as one high-performing function.
  • Direct cross-functional bid teams with authority and hold contributors accountable to deadlines.
  • Make timely, confident decisions under ambiguity and balance risk against win potential.
  • Connect sales, bids, contracts, and delivery, so what we sell is what we can deliver profitably.

Experience:

  • 12+ years in bid, capture, commercial, or business development roles, including 5+ years leading teams at a senior manager, director level, or equivalent.
  • Commercially and sales-savvy: a track record of winning large, complex tenders and a strong understanding of sales cycles, customer relationships, and market positioning.
  • Strategic: able to frame opportunities, set bid strategy, and make clear recommendations to executives.
  • Technically proficient: able to understand and shape technical and operational solutions, engage credibly with SMEs, and turn requirements into compelling, deliverable offers. Comfortable working with data, BI, and planning tools.
  • Financially strong: skilled in financial modeling, pricing, P&L, cash flow, and margin management, and able to defend bid financials with Finance and executive leadership.
  • A confident leader: builds high-performing teams and influences senior stakeholders across functions.
  • Professional fluency in French and English, written and spoken (proficiency in a third language is a bonus). English is required to work with Lyft teams, customers, and partners across North America and internationally.
  • Preferred: APMP or Shipley experience, multi-region bidding,  and a background spanning bid and delivery.

  • Mental health benefits

title: Directeur(trice), Appels d'offres, Stratégie et tarification
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Le directeur ou la directrice, Stratégie des appels d’offres et tarification, dirige la façon dont Lyft Urban Solutions repère, élabore et remporte de nouvelles affaires. Ce poste réunit au sein d’une même fonction la stratégie commerciale, l’intelligence d’affaires, la planification de la demande et la gestion des appels d’offres. À titre de partenaire stratégique et de bras droit du chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, la personne titulaire pilote l'entièreté du cycle de poursuite des occasions d’affaires soit de la stratégie de marché et du positionnement avant les appels d’offres jusqu’au dépôt des soumissions et au transfert aux équipes de réalisation. Nous recherchons un ou une stratège aussi solide sur les plans commercial, technique et financier, qui dirige avec assurance ses équipes et des équipes multifonctionnelles.

Lyft Solutions Urbaines (souvent appelé LUS) crée des programmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service que les usagers adorent, dont les villes ont besoin et que les exploitants apprécient. Nous concevons, fabriquons et soutenons les vélos et la technologie des stations qui font fonctionner des programmes de vélopartage dans des villes du monde entier, dont BIXI. Notre équipe de Montréal est au cœur de ce travail : elle réunit sous un même toit les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'opérations, de marketing et commerciales.

Responsabilités:

Stratégie commerciale, intelligence d’affaires et planification de la demande

  • Définir la stratégie commerciale avec le chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, notamment les marchés cibles, les régions prioritaires et les priorités de croissance.
  • Diriger le ou la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, en matière de planification, de politique de tarification, d’intelligence d’affaires et de planification de la demande.
  • Développer une intelligence d’affaires et une veille sur les appels d’offres (marchés, clients, concurrents et approvisionnement) qui orientent la stratégie, le carnet d’occasions et les décisions de poursuite.
  • Assumer la planification de la demande et les prévisions du carnet d’occasions, en arrimant la capacité et les ressources de l’équipe des appels d’offres aux occasions anticipées et aux cibles de revenus.

Avant l’appel d’offres, capture et décision de soumissionner

  • Responsable du processus à jalons décisionnels que suivent toutes les occasions en avant des appels d’offres, en cohérence avec la stratégie commerciale et les régions cibles.
  • Réaliser des plans de capture pour les occasions stratégiques et ciblées, afin de façonner les occasions bien avant la publication des appels d’offres.
  • Formuler les recommandations de soumissionner ou non, en présentant à la haute direction une vision claire de l’adéquation stratégique, du chemin vers le succès, des risques et du rendement financier.

Stratégie et exécution des soumissions

  • Positionner chaque soumission pour gagner : définir dès le lancement les thèmes gagnants, la proposition de valeur, les éléments de différenciation concurrentielle et le positionnement tarifaire.
  • Façonner les solutions et les offres commerciales avec les équipes d’exploitation, techniques, des finances et des affaires juridiques, afin qu’elles soient concurrentielles, réalisables et rentables.
  • Élaborer et remettre en question les modèles financiers, la tarification et les analyses de rentabilisation des soumissions, en veillant à ce que chaque soumission respecte les seuils de marge convenus.
  • Instaurer une planification rigoureuse des soumissions, avec des jalons, des étapes de revue, des responsables et des échéances claires.

Leadership et partenariats

  • Diriger et faire grandir une équipe composée de gestionnaires d’appels d’offres, de spécialistes, de coordonnateurs et coordonnatrices ainsi que du ou de la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, comme une seule fonction très performante.
  • Diriger avec autorité les équipes multifonctionnelles de soumission et tenir les contributeurs responsables du respect des échéances.
  • Prendre des décisions opportunes et assurées en contexte d’ambiguïté, en équilibrant les risques et le potentiel de gain.
  • Faire le lien entre les ventes, les appels d’offres, les contrats et la réalisation, afin que ce que nous vendons puisse être livré de façon rentable.

Expérience:

  • Plus de 12 ans d’expérience dans des rôles liés aux appels d’offres, à la capture d’affaires, au développement commercial ou au développement des affaires, dont plus de 5 ans à diriger des équipes à titre de gestionnaire principal, de directeur ou l’équivalent.
  • Sens commercial et des ventes : un historique de succès dans des appels d’offres d’envergure et complexes, et une solide compréhension des cycles de vente, des relations clients et du positionnement de marché.
  • Esprit stratégique : capacité à saisir les occasions, à définir la stratégie de soumission et à formuler des recommandations claires à la haute direction.
  • Compétences techniques : capacité à comprendre et à façonner des solutions techniques et opérationnelles, à échanger de façon crédible avec les experts et à transformer les exigences en offres convaincantes et réalisables. À l’aise avec les données, l’intelligence d’affaires et les outils de planification.
  • Solides compétences financières : maîtrise de la modélisation financière, de la tarification, des états des résultats, des flux de trésorerie et de la gestion des marges, et capacité à défendre les données financières des soumissions auprès des finances et de la haute direction.
  • Leadership assuré : capacité à bâtir des équipes très performantes et à influencer les parties prenantes de haut niveau de différentes fonctions.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit (la connaissance d’une troisième langue est un atout). La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour collaborer avec les équipes de Lyft, ainsi qu’avec des clients et des partenaires en Amérique du Nord et à l’international.
  • Atouts : expérience avec les méthodologies APMP ou Shipley, expérience des appels d’offres dans plusieurs régions et parcours combinant appels d’offres et réalisation.

À quoi ressemble la réussite (12 premiers mois)

  • Un processus à jalons décisionnels en amont des appels d’offres et des plans de capture en place pour toutes les occasions stratégiques et ciblées.
  • Une capacité fonctionnelle d’intelligence d’affaires et de planification de la demande qui oriente les décisions liées au carnet d’occasions et aux ressources.
  • Un taux de succès amélioré, chaque soumission reposant sur une stratégie claire et un modèle financier ambitieux mais crédible.
  • Une équipe solide et unie, reconnue comme un partenaire de confiance dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.

Avantages:

  • Excellente couverture d’assurance santé, dentaire, vision, ainsi que l’assurance vie et prestation d’invalidité
  • Programme de soutien en santé mentale
  • Soutien à la fertilité et à la planification familiale
  • Avantage pour les soins d'animaux de compagnie
  • Compte de dépenses de santé (HSA)
  • Options de cotisation pour le REER
  • En plus des jours fériés observés dans la province, les membres salariés de l’équipe sont couverts par la politique flexible de congés payés de Lyft. La politique permet aux membres de l’équipe de prendre autant de temps qu’ils en ont besoin (avec l’approbation du gestionnaire). Les membres de l’équipe payés à l’heure bénéficient de 15 jours de congés payés, avec un jour supplémentaire pour chaque année de service
  • Lyft est fier de soutenir les nouveaux parents avec 18 semaines de congés payés, conçu comme une complémentarité aux programmes gouvernementaux. Les parents biologiques, adoptifs et adoptifs sont tous élus.
  • Avantage lié au transport
